preFlight: confirm go/no-go record is pass and developer-only
confirm final alpha safety checklist remains all PASS
confirm approved primary region matches current review target
confirm rollback owner is available before session start

executionSequence.instruction: Verify all runtime and renderer flags remain false.
Verify the approved region and internal-only user boundary before proceeding.
Rehearse metadata-only coordinate lookup notes without runtime activation.
Observe monitoring outputs for healthy, warning, blocked, and shutdown signals.
Exit within the timebox and complete audit notes whether successful or stopped.

stopConditions: runtimeExecutionEnabled becomes true without manual authorization
mapAttachmentAllowed becomes true outside approved experiment review
package validation enters blocked state for permitted region
monitoring emits emergency shutdown or unresolved blocked condition
rollbackProcedure: end session if any failure criteria or emergency signal is observed

exitAudit: retain monitored alert and telemetry references
retain rollback invocation note if used
